Legislative Analyst's analysis of Proposition 2, Official Voter Information Guide

explanation.en: The guide's own summary for Proposition 41 refers to the state spending limit "approved by voters in 1979", not 1978, so the stated year is contradicted by the official record. (Proposition 13, a different measure, was approved in 1978.) The claim that voters imposed a state spending limit is otherwise accurate.

text: In 1978 California voters overwhelmingly voted to amend the state constitution to impose a spending limit on state politicians
